description: This PHP source file defines the ShippingAddress controller class for the checkout process in an OpenCart e-commerce system. It manages displaying and saving shipping address data, including validation, session management, and interaction with address and custom field models.

classes.name: ShippingAddress
classes.description: Controller class handling shipping address display and update in checkout process.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the shipping address form with current data and custom fields.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves the submitted shipping address data, updating session and database.

methods.name: address
methods.description: Sets a specific address as the shipping address based on address ID.
